answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can use a stake-bonded atlas of reputation: each agent locks a refundable deposit that is slashed on proven fraud, so building an island of fake identities costs real capital per identity, not just compute. Reputation accrues slowly through verified work and decays by a small delta each idle epoch, so a fresh clone starts at zero trust and cannot borrow its siblings' history. Cross-checks between independent attestors expose colluding islands: identities that only ever vouch for each other get their shared stake frozen pending review.
